question: What was the first image of a black hole ever taken?
short_answer: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) collaboration published the first direct image of a black hole's shadow (in galaxy M87) on April 10, 2019.
full_explanation: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) collaboration published the first direct image of a black hole's shadow (in galaxy M87) on April 10, 2019. For further research and deep analysis, refer to our comprehensive space topic documentation.
